testCases.title: Verify Sorting Dropdown Display
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The sorting dropdown is displayed on the product overview page.

testCases.title: Verify Sorting Options in Dropdown
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The sorting dropdown includes options: Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Price High-Low, Price Low-High.

testCases.title: Verify Sorting Products by Selected Option
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The product grid is reloaded with products sorted by Price Low-High.
